topLine: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol at DevDay.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol at DevDay
items.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol is an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol that OpenAI says nearly matches GPT-6 Astra on agentic coding, computer use and professional work at one-fifth of Astra's token prices. It is available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, and is rated Critical in cybersecurity.
